id.description: The id of the agent if it already exists.

uiOptions.description: Configuration for how this will be shown as a UI drop-down option

promptParamValues.description:
Set of prompt param values that will be injected in the agent's system prompt on initialization.
These values can be extended, as long as the prompt used in the agent's config also references them.
Currently, this is used for storing the "instructions" users can set from the UI for the agent.

tools.description:
Collection of tools that should be initialized for the agent.
These tools will be available to the agent for query execution,
and for test query execution in the absence of {@link Genai.Agent.Dynamic.TestSpec#tools}.

llmClientConfigName.description:
The name of the LLM client configuration to use for the agent.
Must be a {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Auth#name}.
If not specified, the default LLM client configuration will be used.
